answer: One threshold for every key: Parchment finisher goat mark stretched on the stretching frame, and one receipt, each goat is a measured skin yield plus a parchmenter's signature, no matter whose hand carries it. The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch. 730 seats means 730 proofs at 201 POA apiece, and the 146730 POA leaves the farm's hands before the epoch starts. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the terrace is the pass, the tundra is the fare, the vine is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price.
